notes: Inductive-clarity pass (2026-10-19): one new thing per sentence where the diagram or a contrast can carry it; у + genitive introduced as place (у пе́чи) before possession; почему́ answered by потому́ что in the next line; exercises trimmed to three per section, each using only words read by the end of that section; второ́го and краси́вый dropped as unanchored one-offs.

Warnings left, with reasons: prior coverage 57% (bootstrap floor 70%): the izba inventory and the money vocabulary are new together (35 planned lexemes, 13 known to the owner); new-cluster in the counting and possession sentences (оди́н рубль, две копе́йки… is a list of new numerals by design); stress-unverified by design. де́ньги is listed as a form in the delta because the analyser lemmatises it to деньга (Q-T4), so the checker can match it literally.
Still no present tense outside the G02 whitelist: the search is told through Где? Нет. у + genitive / нет + genitive, and the bargain through possession (Коро́ва на́ша, а рубль — Сила́нтия).

Running jokes kept: Шарик is looked at first (here innocent: he sleeps); Pyotr's «Ты большо́й» from Глава 2 is reused for Fyodor («Потому́ что ты большо́й»), and «А у Ива́на — доска́» pays off Ivan mending the slate.
Глава 6 and later chapters: the family owes Силантий a rouble paid and two days of Fyodor's work; Fyodor's anger at Силантий is seeded (he goes red and says nothing).
One-off glossed words (not lexemes; Часть 1 has no open slots): ведро́, ест (G02 whitelist), второ́го, дня (день is a Глава 4 lexeme), краси́вый in a gloss.

review_questions.question: Ded explains «кра́сный у́гол» to a child with the old sense (кра́сный = краси́вый, baseline-known, glossed) and the icon: fine for a grandfather's answer?
«Он кра́сный» for 'he goes red with anger' (narration, present tense): natural, or «Он весь кра́сный» (весь is a Глава 4 lexeme)?

[?] Economic plausibility: four young cabbages priced at two roubles, settled for one rouble plus two days of a grown man's work (May 1913, Ryazan province). The history notes give no prices or day wages; please judge or supply a source.

[?] Material culture assumed, not sourced: the wooden milk pail, the izba layout (stove by the door, icon corner diagonally opposite, one small window on the street side), the village shop with sacks and a barrel, coins of 1913 (silver rouble, copper kopecks).

primary_new_grammar.label: Genitive singular of nouns, adjectives, possessives and pronouns: possession (дом Петра́), у + gen есть, нет + gen; свой; 2–4 + gen. sg

cover.art_brief: Interior of a Ryazan peasant izba, early May 1913, morning light through one small window. The huge whitewashed Russian stove takes a quarter of the room; Ded Matvei (70, white beard) sits beside it. words_with_history.title: Слова́ с исто́рией
text: Пётр Матве́евич — хозя́ин избы́. Сила́нтий Кузьми́ч — хозя́ин ла́вки, до́ма и огоро́да.
А Ма́рья Степа́новна смо́трит и говори́т: «Хозя́ин? Хозя́йка до́ма — коро́ва!»
words_with_history.note_en: Хозя́ин is the master of a household, the owner of a shop, the host of a guest; хозя́йка is the woman of the house. The proverb: 'without its master a house is an orphan'.

grammar.title: У кого́? Чей?
grammar.rule: коро́ва → у коро́вы, нет коро́вы · сосе́д → у сосе́да · печь → у пе́чи · окно́ → у окна́ · он → у него́ · два рубля́, две копе́йки

tables.caption: кто? что? → у кого́? у чего́?

grammar.note_en: The genitive answers 'whose?' and 'of what?': изба́ отца́, хозя́ин ла́вки. It follows у ('at, by'; у меня́ есть = I have) and нет ('there is no': коро́вы нет). Endings: м./ср. -а/-я, ж. -ы/-и. After 2, 3, 4 a noun stands in the genitive singular (два рубля́, две копе́йки). Third-person pronouns add н- after у: у него́, у неё, у них.
